Raw quarterly filings contain overlapping trailing-12-month contexts for the same concept and fy/fp. Their window crosses calendar-year boundaries and has no observed annual anchor. Existing conservative target-rejection contract blocks quarter scalars and arithmetic operands; TTM is explicitly out of scope. Independent numeric differences remain recorded but are not admissible results.

initial_hypothesis.omission: Competing TTM contexts / missing same-concept annual anchor not inspected in first literal-only ledger
